attchmntText: EIH Limited has informed the Exchange about Capacity addition
voiceSummary: EIH Limited approved the construction of a Trident five-star deluxe hotel near Shamshabad Airport, Hyderabad, during its Board Meeting on 12th November 2026. The project is situated on an 8.89-acre site owned by the Company. The estimated investment required is Rs. 777 crores. Financing will be through internal accrual and debt. The hotel is expected to be operational by September 2030. It will cater to domestic and international travelers. The initiative is part of the Company's portfolio expansion in the domestic tourism sector. The Board Meeting started at 04:00 p.m. and concluded at about 6.15 p.m. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: EIH Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: EIH Limited disclosed that its subsidiary Svara Hotels Limited received alternate land from the Government of Andhra Pradesh for the Trident Tirupati project. The facility is a five-star hotel with 124 keys, 132 bays, and 8 suites. The revised investment estimate is Rs. 344 crores. The hotel is scheduled to be in operation by March 2030. Financing will be through internal accruals and debt. The project caters to domestic and international travelers. This disclosure is under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: EIH Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: EIH Limited reported Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 12th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 621.67 Crores. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 155.31 Crores. Profit for the period was Rs. 117.20 Crores. Earnings per share were Rs. 1.88. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 1,221.47 Crores. Profit before tax was Rs. 325.03 Crores. Profit for the period was Rs. 244.29 Crores. Earnings per share were Rs. 3.91. Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued a Limited Review Report on the financial results.
